summary: Selection-sorts the global vehicle array by a composite string key. After initializing a temporary buffer with sub_4C3050, for each position (1060-byte stride) it finds the best remaining entry with CompositeStringCompare, then swaps it into place: the current entry is preserved into the temporary buffer (string realloc-copies, integer dword copies and raw byte-block copies of 8..256 bytes), and VehicleDataCopy moves entries between array slots. Runs only when entry count dword_8AC390 > 0 and finishes with MultiFieldCleanup on the temporary buffer.

operations.description: Initialize the temporary vehicle-entry buffer with sub_4C3050(&temp).
Run the sort only when entry count dword_8AC390 is greater than 0.
Outer pass: for each position in the vehicle array at dword_8AC394 (1060-byte stride), locate the best remaining entry; condition re-reads dword_8AC390 each iteration.
Inner scan: compare each remaining entry at dword_8AC394 + offset against the current best using CompositeStringCompare, tracking the winning index.
Only swap when the best entry index differs from the current position.
Null-safe dereference of the string fields at current entry offsets 0, 8, 16, 24 and 32 via NullSafePointerDereference.
Realloc-copy each of those string fields into the temporary buffer via StringCopyWithBufferRealloc.

Copy the remaining entry fields into the temporary buffer: a 16-byte block, dwords at offsets 56 through 112, then byte-block loops of sizes 8, 64, 64, 64, 64, 64, 256, 128, 16, 64, 16, 16, 16, 16, plus a final 64-byte block.
Null-safe dereference and realloc-copy of the string at entry offset 972 and the string at entry offset 984.
Copy the dwords at entry offsets 980 and 1056 into the temporary buffer.
Invoke VehicleDataCopy(1060 * bestIndex + dword_8AC394) with the best entry's array slot address.
Invoke VehicleDataCopy(&temp) with the temporary buffer address.
Clean up the temporary buffer and return its result: MultiFieldCleanup(&temp).
